about: Canvas rendering, input and eraser work (docs/perf/README.md). Counts are budgets enforced by apps/ios/Tests/VellumCoreTests/CanvasRenderingBudgetTests.swift; times are main-thread busy time per frame from the Debug benchmark on the iPhone Duo simulator in CI, compared by apps/ios/Scripts/perf-compare.py with a warning at 25% worse.

entries.note: A pan, and a pinch within a level, after the view was drawn once. Main built a path for every visible stroke on every redraw.

A 60 x 30 pt stroke in the middle of the screen at zoom to everything: the 4 tiles it touches (the tile anchor sits at the screen centre, the worst case). Main redrew the whole 951 x 669 view, background and grid included.
Culling a view at 4x the zoom of everything. Main compared every stroke.
Bounds are cached in the index. Main recomputed every stroke's bounds from its points on every redraw.
Mean over the benchmark's 479-sample sweep at everything, tolerance 8 pt. Main recomputed every stroke's bounds and measured every segment of strokes near the tip.
Most points turned into path on one Pencil move over a 10,000-sample stroke, two samples and two predictions a move. Main rebuilt the whole stroke every move.
